facts.claim: Mentors must have at least 5 years of experience in the MSME sector.
facts.subject: mentor
facts.evidence: a) The mentors will be entrepreneurs/industrialists who has at least 5 years of experience in running an enterprise, or b) Experienced Professionals or group of professionals like Chartered Engineers, Chartered/Cost Accountants, retired Bank officials, Management consultants and other professionals having experience of at least 5 years in the MSME sector and desirous of providing mentorship with the ability to bring in interventions in the areas of technology/marketing/finance/information support.

facts.claim: Benefits for activities 2, 3, 4 and 5 for an MSE can be claimed only by one SNP.
facts.subject: benefits_activities_2_3_4_5
facts.evidence: 2) The benefits for activities 2, 3, 4 and 5 for an MSE can be claimed only by one SNP. The benefits under activity 6 would be payable directly to IIP through the IA.

facts.subject: mse_ai_cataloguing

facts.claim: No single SNP can claim benefits of more than 20% of the budget allocated for any of the activities listed in section 4.
facts.subject: snp_benefit_limit
facts.evidence: 4) No single SNP shall be allowed to claim benefits of more than 20% of budget allocated for any of the activities listed at 2-5 in section 4 of the Operating Guidelines of this initiative.

facts.claim: MSEs joining the network for B2B archetype are encouraged to bring their existing buyer base online.
facts.subject: mse_b2b_participation
facts.evidence: 5) The B2B transactions require a certain level of trust and association which takes time and transactions to develop. Hence, MSEs that join the network for the B2B archetype, will be encouraged to bring a set of their existing buyer base online as far as a possible as it will help drive initial volume and also help the sellers build their reputation on the network.

facts.claim: Udyam Registration is free of cost and paperless.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: Udyam Registration : Zero cost, No Fee and Free Registration of MSMEs.

facts.claim: Udyam Registration is the only official website for MSME registration by the Government of India.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: This is official website of Govt. of India, Ministry of MSME. No other website/portal/app is official. MSMEs are requested to do MSME Registration here only

facts.claim: MSME registration process is fully online and paperless.
facts.subject: msme_registration
facts.evidence: MSME registration process is fully online, paperless and based on self-declaration.

facts.claim: No documents or proof are required to be uploaded for registering an MSME.
facts.subject: msme_registration
facts.evidence: No documents or proof are required to be uploaded for registering an MSME.

facts.claim: Only an Aadhaar Number is enough for registration.
facts.subject: msme_registration
facts.evidence: Only Adhaar Number will be enough for registration.

facts.claim: PAN and GSTIN are required for Udyam Registration as per the CGST Act 2017 and as notified by the Ministry of MSME.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: Having PAN and GSTIN (As per applicablity of CGST Act 2017 and as notified by the ministry of MSME vide S.O. 1055(E) dated 05th March 2021 ) is required for Udyam Registration with effect from 01.04.2021.

facts.claim: Those who have EM-II or UAM registration or any other registration issued by any authority under the Ministry of MSME will have to re-register themselves.
facts.subject: msme_registration
facts.evidence: Those who have EM-II or UAM registration or any other registration issued by any authority under the Ministry of MSME, will have to re-register themselves.

facts.claim: No enterprise shall file more than one Udyam Registration.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: No enterprise shall file more than one Udyam Registration.

facts.claim: A permanent registration number will be given after registration.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: A permanent registration number will be given after registration.

facts.claim: After completion of the registration process, a certificate will be issued online.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: After completion of the process of registration, a certificate will be issued online.

facts.claim: The certificate will have a dynamic QR Code from which the web page on the portal and details about the enterprise can be accessed.
facts.subject: udyam_certificate
facts.evidence: This certificate will have a dynamic QR Code from which the web page on our Portal and details about the enterprise can be accessed.

facts.claim: There will be no need for renewal of Registration.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: There will be no need for renewal of Registration.

facts.claim: The single window systems at Champions Control Rooms and at DICs will help in the process.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: Our single window systems at Champions Control Rooms and at DICs will help you in the process.

facts.claim: The online system will be fully integrated with Income Tax and GSTIN systems.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: Our online system will be fully integrated with Income Tax and GSTIN systems.

facts.claim: For grievances, call or WhatsApp on +91 8308809334 from Monday to Friday between 10:00 AM and 06:00 PM.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: Call or Whatsapp on +91 8308809334 Mon to Fri : 10:00 AM - 06:00 PM

facts.claim: Aadhaar number is required for Udyam Registration.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: ✔ Aadhaar number shall be required for Udyam Registration.

facts.claim: The Aadhaar number must be of the proprietor for a proprietorship firm.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: ✔ The Aadhaar number shall be of the proprietor in the case of a proprietorship firm, of the managing partner in the case of a partnership firm and of a karta in the case of a Hindu Undivided Family (HUF).

facts.claim: For a Company or a Limited Liability Partnership, GSTIN and PAN along with Aadhaar number are required.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: ✔ In case of a Company or a Limited Liability Partnership or a Cooperative Society or a Society or a Trust, the organisation or its authorised signatory shall provide its GSTIN(As per applicablity of CGST Act 2017 and as notified by the ministry of MSME vide S.O. 1055(E) dated 05th March 2021 ) and PAN along with its Aadhaar number.

facts.claim: Aadhaar data will not be stored or shared by the Ministry of MSME.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: Ministry of MSME, Government of India, have informed me that my aadhaar data will not be stored/shared.

facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: For Grievances Call or Whatsapp on +91 8308809334

facts.evidence: MSMEs are requested to do MSME Registration here only

facts.evidence: Website hosted & managed by National Informatics Centre , Ministry of Electronics and IT , Government of India

facts.claim: Only Udyam registered Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) under manufacturing and services sectors are eligible for benefits under the Initiative.
facts.subject: udyam_registered_mses
facts.evidence: All the Udyam registered Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) under manufacturing and services sectors will be eligible for benefits under the Initiative.

facts.claim: Udyam registered MSEs without GST can only do intra-state online business.
facts.subject: udyam_registered_mses_without_gst
facts.evidence: The MSEs who have Udyam Registration certificate without a GST will only be able to do intra-state online business as per applicable laws.

facts.claim: MSEs must not have been onboarded on any SNP as of the date of operationalisation of the Initiative.
facts.subject: mses
facts.evidence: The MSE should not have been onboarded on any SNP as on the date of operationalisation of the Initiative.

facts.claim: MSE units must not have taken similar assistance from any other Central or State Government schemes or programmes.
facts.subject: mse_units
facts.evidence: The MSE unit should not have taken similar assistance from any other Central / State Government schemes / programmes.

facts.claim: MSEs must authorize ONDC to share their relevant details, including transactions on the ONDC Network, with the Implementing Agency (NSIC).
facts.subject: mses
facts.evidence: The MSEs who want to avail benefits under this Initiative shall authorize ONDC to share their relevant details, including transactions on the ONDC Network, with the Implementing Agency (NSIC) for the purpose of scheme administration and support, in compliance with applicable laws.

facts.claim: The eligible fixed capital investment of the project is decided based on specific criteria.
facts.subject: eligible_fixed_capital_investment
facts.evidence: The eligible fixed capital investment of the project will be decided on the basis of following criteria.

facts.claim: The cost of land is decided based on the prevailing policy of GIDC in unsaturated estates.
facts.subject: cost_of_land
facts.evidence: Cost of Land: The cost of land will be decided on the basis of prevailing policy of (:~!DC in unsaturated estates.

facts.claim: The cost of building is fixed by SLAG for the industrial building based on the prevailing SOR of the Road and Building department.
facts.subject: cost_of_building
facts.evidence: Cost of Building: The cost of building shall be fixed up by SLAG for the lndustri::}l Building based on prevailingSOR of the Road and Building department.

facts.claim: The cost of other infrastructure facilities is decided by SLEC based on relevant available SOR or any other agency as approved by SLEC.
facts.subject: cost_of_infrastructure
facts.evidence: Other lnfrastr~cture Facilities: The cost of other infrastructure facilities will be as decided by SLEC, based on relevant available SOR if any or any other agency as approved by SLEC.

facts.claim: GIDC will identify potential areas or locations in the state where MSEs can be set up.
facts.subject: g_idc
facts.evidence: GIDC will identify potential area I locations in the state where MSEs can be set up.

facts.claim: GIDC may purchase or acquire new land for the development of estates.
facts.subject: g_idc
facts.evidence: GIDC may purchase/acquirenew land for development of estates.

facts.claim: GIDC will prepare a development plan for infrastructure facilities needed for the MSEs for the estate and work out the project cost.
facts.subject: g_idc
facts.evidence: GIDC will prepare a development plan for infrastructure facilities needed for the MSEs for the estate and work out the project cost.

facts.claim: GIDC will submit a detailed proposal to the Industries Commissioner.
facts.subject: g_idc
facts.evidence: GIDC will submit detailed proposal to Industries Commissioner.

facts.claim: Industries Commissioner will scrutinize the proposal and submit it to the State Level Empowered Committee (SLEC).
facts.subject: industries_commissioner
facts.evidence: Industries Commissioner will scrutinize the proposal and submit the proposal to the State Level Empowered Committee (SLEC).

facts.claim: SLEC will sanction the proposal.
facts.subject: s_l_e_c
facts.evidence: SLEC will sanction the proposal.

facts.claim: The assistance up to 50% of the allotment price fixed by SLEC will be given directly to GIDC.
facts.subject: assistance
facts.evidence: The assistance up to 50% of allotment price fixed by SLEC will be given directly to GIDC.

facts.claim: GIDC will pass on the concession or assistance to MSEs.
facts.subject: g_idc
facts.evidence: GIDC will subsequently pass on such concession/assistance to MSEs.

facts.claim: The plot size shall be approximately 500 Sq.Mts. to 1000 Sq. Mts.
facts.subject: plot_size
facts.evidence: 1. The plot size shall be approximately of 500 Sq.Mts. to 1000 Sq. Mts.

facts.claim: GIDC must develop the estate within three years from the date of sanction or procurement of land, whichever is earlier.
facts.subject: g_idc
facts.evidence: 2. GIDC shall have to develop the estate within three years from the date o: sanction or procurement of land whichever is earlier.

facts.claim: Proposals for providing assistance to beneficiaries must be forwarded by the Implementing Agency (IA) with their specific recommendations to the Nodal Agency (NA).
facts.subject: implementing_agency
facts.evidence: 4.2 All the proposals for providing assistance to beneficiaries under the scheme will be forwarded by IA alongwith their specific recommendations to the Nodal Agency (NA). The NA after scrutinizing the proposals will put up to Screening Committee for sanction or otherwise.

facts.claim: The Nodal Agency (NA) must scrutinize the proposals and submit them to the Screening Committee for sanction or otherwise.
facts.subject: nodal_agency
facts.evidence: 4.2 All the proposals for providing assistance to beneficiaries under the scheme will be forwarded by IA alongwith their specific recommendations to the Nodal Agency (NA). The NA after scrutinizing the proposals will put up to Screening Committee for sanction or otherwise.

facts.claim: The Screening Committee must regularly review the progress of the Scheme and issue executive instructions, with the approval of the Secretary (MSME).
facts.subject: screening_committee
facts.evidence: 4.3 Screening Committee would regularly review the progress of the Scheme and whenever necessary for the smooth functioning of the scheme, issue suitable executive instructions, with the approval of Secretary (MSME).

facts.claim: The Screening Committee must meet once a month to consider proposals and review the progress of the scheme.
facts.subject: screening_committee_meeting
facts.evidence: 4.4 The Screening Committee will meet once in a month to consider proposals received under the scheme and also to review/monitor the progress of the scheme.

facts.claim: Implementing Agencies (IAs) must screen applications of Mentors for empanelment as per the eligibility criteria under the scheme.
facts.subject: implementing_agency
facts.evidence: a) Screen the applications of Mentors for empanelling them as per eligibility criteria under the scheme.

facts.claim: Implementing Agencies (IAs) must prepare and maintain a panel of Mentors on the existing scheme portal.
facts.subject: implementing_agency
facts.evidence: b) Prepare and maintain a panel of Mentors on the existing scheme portal.

facts.claim: Implementing Agencies (IAs) must screen applications of prospective entrepreneurs and existing entrepreneurs for improving their performance, as per the eligibility criteria under the scheme.
facts.subject: implementing_agency
facts.evidence: c) Screen the application(s) of prospective entrepreneurs willing to set up their enterprise and / or existing entrepreneur for improving their performance, as per the eligibility criteria under the scheme along with the proposal(s) of the mentors for hand-holding of target beneficiaries together with milestones for doing the same.

facts.claim: Implementing Agencies (IAs) must prepare data on all applications received from new and existing entrepreneurs under the mentoring support on the existing scheme portal.
facts.subject: implementing_agency
facts.evidence: d) Prepare Data on all applications received from new and existing entrepreneurs under the mentoring support on the existing scheme portal.

facts.claim: Implementing Agencies (IAs) must forward completed applications to the BASP Cell in the Ministry of MSME along with their recommendations.
facts.subject: implementing_agency
facts.evidence: e) Forward completed applications received from the target beneficiaries along with their recommendations to BASP Cell in the Ministry of MSME.

facts.claim: Implementing Agencies (IAs) must provide a dedicated officer to work as a nodal contact under the scheme.
facts.subject: implementing_agency
facts.evidence: f) Provide dedicated officer to work as a nodal contact under the scheme.

facts.claim: Implementing Agencies (IAs) must maintain important information and data, including acts, rules, regulations, forms, and information about schemes and industrial sectors.
facts.subject: implementing_agency
facts.evidence: g) Maintain important information and data, copies of different acts, rules and regulations, forms, website containing market related information, information about schemes/subsidies/grants and data relating to different industrial sectors.

facts.claim: Implementing Agencies (IAs) must review and monitor the progress of beneficiaries approved by the Screening Committee and report it to the Ministry of MSME/NA on a quarterly basis.
facts.subject: implementing_agency
facts.evidence: h) Review and monitor progress of the beneficiaries approved by the Screening Committee and being assisted under the Scheme. The progress in all such cases to be reported to Ministry of MSME/NA on quarterly basis.

facts.claim: Implementing Agencies (IAs) must make recommendations about the release of assistance to mentors based on the milestones achieved.
facts.subject: implementing_agency
facts.evidence: i) Make recommendations about the release of assistance to the mentors linking it with the milestones achieved.

facts.claim: Mentors must guide potential entrepreneurs on procedural and legal formalities required to set up a new business enterprise.
facts.subject: mentor
facts.evidence: 6.1 For Start-up Units Mentors will play an advisory role and guide the potential entrepreneurs on the procedural and legal formalities required to be completed for setting up new business enterprise.
